sub_question: SQ-1: Any published T-DXd or DXd/exatecan + ferroptosis data?

critical_finding.citation: Zou Y et al. Drug Resist Updat. 2024 Nov;77:101126.
critical_finding.title: crVDAC3 alleviates ferroptosis by impeding HSPB1 ubiquitination and confers trastuzumab deruxtecan resistance in HER2-low breast cancer.
key_findings: T-DXd directly induces ferroptosis in HER2-low breast cancer — directly confirmed (not class analogy)
crVDAC3 (circular RNA from VDAC3) is the resistance mechanism: impedes HSPB1 ubiquitination → HSPB1 accumulates → ferroptosis inhibited → T-DXd resistance
VDAC3 is a mitochondrial outer membrane channel — confirms the mtDNA/mitochondrial dysfunction arm of the hypothesis
HSPB1 (heat shock protein B1) is the ferroptosis suppressor — distinct from SLC7A11/NRF2 axis
critical_finding.implications_for_hypothesis: This REPLACES the CPT-class analogy with direct T-DXd ferroptosis evidence. The hypothesis was correct. The resistance mechanism identified in this paper (VDAC3-HSPB1, mitochondrial) is DIFFERENT from our proposed mechanism (NRF2-SLC7A11, transcriptional). Both could coexist as parallel resistance axes.

mechanistic_update.original_claim: T-DXd → TOP1mt → mtDNA breaks → ROS → ferroptosis; HER2 internalization → PI3K-NRF2-SLC7A11 suppression
mechanistic_update.updated_claim: T-DXd directly induces ferroptosis (CONFIRMED, PMID 39243601). Mitochondrial axis: DXd → TOP1mt → VDAC3 disruption → HSPB1 ubiquitination → ferroptosis (confirmed). SLC7A11 axis: HER2 internalization → PI3K-NRF2-SLC7A11 suppression → independent ferroptosis sensitization (still novel, not yet published).

axis_2_transcriptional.mechanism: NRF2-SLC7A11 transcriptional upregulation in SLC7A11-high tumors → ferroptosis escape
axis_2_transcriptional.status: NOVEL — not yet published for T-DXd

evidential_quality.rationale: T-DXd ferroptosis directly confirmed by PMID 39243601. No longer class analogy. Ceiling raised because DXd-specific mechanistic data now exists. SLC7A11 arm still novel.

novelty.rationale: Ferroptosis link is now published; SLC7A11/NRF2 as parallel resistance axis remains unpublished and novel. Reduction modest.

clinical_relevance.rationale: HER2-low paper confirms the mechanism is relevant to the entire HER2-targeting landscape, not just HER2-amplified. Broader clinical impact.

recommended_actions: Create hyp-her2-001-v3 incorporating PMID 39243601 and dual-axis resistance model
Proceed to HER2-EXP-002 (DESTINY-Breast clinical data) + HER2-EXP-003 (NRF2-SLC7A11 pathway) in parallel
Differentiate hypothesis: focus novelty claim on SLC7A11 transcriptional axis (VDAC3-HSPB1 axis is now prior art)
Add VDAC3/HSPB1 as potential co-biomarker panel with SLC7A11 for T-DXd patient stratification
